title: user.merged
description: Consumed from stapel-auth. An anonymous guest account was absorbed into an existing account; the guest row ceases to exist. Reviews reassigns the guest's authored reviews and responses to the surviving account, so a rating left before signing in is neither orphaned nor cascaded away. Where a target type sets one_per_author and both accounts reviewed the same target, the survivor's review wins and the guest's duplicate is dropped — emitting reviews.review.hidden if it was published, so a host's avg_rating projection shrinks with it. Contract owned by the emitter.
